location: Discussion, paragraph 3 (and Results, Region 1 section; Table I)
quote: Allele A of rs1447295 was not associated with risk of prostate cancer in Tobago men.
reason: The replication study (Okobia et al., 2011, p. 4, Table I) tested the association of SNP rs1447295 allele A with prostate cancer in Tobago men to replicate Amundadottir et al.'s (2006) Icelandic cohort finding and explicitly reported no association (OR = 0.83, P = 0.19).
